# Zelvior Vibecoding Mega Skill

> Made by **Zelvior Labs**. A senior-level mega skill for building production websites and apps that pass a strict, opinionated audit. It routes any web or coding task to the right design, backend, security, SEO, performance, accessibility, and audit knowledge, then verifies the result against a 236-test audit.

## Summary

Zelvior Vibecoding Mega Skill is a description-driven routing system for AI coding agents that read `SKILL.md` files. Instead of dumping all knowledge at once, the agent loads only the reference guides and subskills relevant to the task. It bundles 12 deep-dive guides, 138 page/screen/design-system/flow checklists, a 236-test audit across 32 modules, an anti-slop frontend craft skill, a lean minimal-change coding mode, a UI styling knowledge set, and behavioral coding guidelines.

## What it provides

- **Mega skill** (`zelvior-vibecoding-skill/SKILL.md`): the routing entry point and the design must-haves / banned patterns, backend, security, SEO, performance, accessibility, CRO, DevOps, and definition-of-done knowledge.
- **12 reference guides** (`zelvior-vibecoding-skill/references/`): design system, anti-patterns, backend, frontend/data, SEO, security, performance, accessibility/mobile, CRO, DevOps/SRE, audit, AI search.
- **138 checklists** (`references/13`–`17`): website page types, web-app screens, design-system foundations, mobile screens, and user flows — every item is a required test.
- **236-test audit**: a local `scripts/audit.py` checker plus a full manual checklist across 32 modules.
- **21 subskills** (`subskills/`): core knowledge skills, the `zelvior-craft` anti-slop frontend skill, the `zelvior-lean` minimal-change family, the `zelvior-ui` styling router, and `zelvior-discipline` behavioral guidelines.
- **Scripts**: `scripts/audit.py` (stdlib-only, Python 3.6+) and `scripts/compat.py` (environment probe → FULL / PARTIAL / MANUAL).
- **Assets**: `robots.txt`, `llms.txt`, `security.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `404.html`.

## Quick start

```bash
python3 zelvior-vibecoding-skill/scripts/compat.py            # check environment
python3 zelvior-vibecoding-skill/scripts/audit.py https://example.com
```
